psa_ssaf_2022.title: Selected Statistics on Agriculture and Fisheries 2022

gaez_manifest.use: documents that inherited OARs are agro-climatic potential yields and that sugarcane is kg sugar/ha while tomato is kg dry weight/ha

rice_irrigated.production_source: PSA OpenSTAT palay/corn production, Irrigated Palay, Philippines, 2020 Annual
rice_irrigated.area_source: PSA Selected Statistics on Agriculture and Fisheries 2022, 2020 irrigation service area

rice_rainfed.area_basis: harvested area used as physical-area proxy because a separate rainfed service-area series is unavailable
rice_rainfed.production_source: PSA OpenSTAT palay/corn production, Rainfed Palay, Philippines, 2020 Annual
rice_rainfed.area_source: PSA OpenSTAT palay/corn area harvested, Rainfed Palay, Philippines, 2020 Annual

corn.area_basis: harvested area used as annual crop-area proxy
corn.production_source: PSA OpenSTAT palay/corn production, Corn, Philippines, 2020 Annual
corn.area_source: PSA OpenSTAT palay/corn area harvested, Corn, Philippines, 2020 Annual

coconut.production_source: PSA OpenSTAT major crops production, Coconut (w/ husk), Philippines, 2020 Annual
coconut.area_source: PSA OpenSTAT major crops area planted/harvested, Coconut, Philippines, 2020 Annual

sugarcane.production_basis: fresh sugar cane, not sugar equivalent
sugarcane.production_source: PSA OpenSTAT major crops production, Sugarcane, Philippines, 2020 Annual
sugarcane.area_source: PSA OpenSTAT major crops area planted/harvested, Sugarcane, Philippines, 2020 Annual

other_vegetables_fresh_nec.production_basis: Other vegetables, fresh n.e.c.; not tomato dry matter

other_crops_aggregate.production_basis: sum of retained model aggregate tonnes

calculation.application: set the calculated OAR uniformly across the existing eight clusters and the listed modes for every model year
calculation.gaez_role_after_change: benchmark and potential-yield evidence only; absolute GAEZ potential is not used as achieved OAR
